title: Google's obsession with AI is killing what made Pixel phones special
excerpt: I miss when the Pixel solved problems instead of chasing AI trends
content_html:
Published Aug 10, 2026, 8:15 AM EDT

Dhruv Bhutani has covered the Android ecosystem since 2010, with a focus on smartphones, connected devices, and home networking. His reporting is informed by hands-on experience reviewing hundreds of smartphones and testing a wide range of smart home and audio products over more than a decade. He has attended Mobile World Congress eight times since 2011 and IFA Berlin five times, alongside regular coverage of launch events and industry briefings from companies including Google, Xiaomi, Oppo, and Qualcomm. This on-ground access and long-term exposure to product cycles inform how he evaluates hardware, software direction, and ecosystem shifts.

First-Hand Experience

Reviewed and tested hundreds of smartphones since 2009

Tested smart home, audio, and connected devices across multiple categories

Attended Mobile World Congress (8 times, first in 2011)

Attended IFA Berlin (5 times)

Covered industry events including Qualcomm Summit and launch events from Google, Xiaomi, Oppo, and Vivo

If you've been following Google's Pixel smartphones over the last few years, you've probably noticed one recurring theme.

Nearly every headline feature revolves around AI. From AI-powered image generation and photo editing to writing tools and spam filtering, the conversation almost always comes back to artificial intelligence.

Some of those features are genuinely useful while others feel more like tech demos, but one thing is clear: It's been a long time since practical software innovation and experimentation were Google's biggest priorities.

Practical innovation is what made the Pixel special

Features like Now Playing and Active Edge became part of my routine

Lately, I find myself thinking back to the early years of the Pixel.

What drew me to the lineup wasn't AI. It was Google's willingness to experiment with interesting hardware ideas and pair them with software features that solved real, everyday problems.

The Pixel brand felt better when Google wasn't neck-deep in AI and was instead focused on improving the experience of using your phone in practical, meaningful ways.

One of the best examples of this is Now Playing. The feature is a staple of Pixel phones and identifies music playing around you. Further, it can show you the title and artist name directly on the lock screen. And the best part is that it works completely offline.

Before on-device AI was a thing, Google figured out how to compress a database with waveforms of the top 10,000 most popular tracks so that your phone could recognize music even without internet access.

It's a feature I've used hundreds, if not thousands, of times. Be it while sitting at a café or when traveling a thousand miles from home, if a track catches my fancy, I can glance at my phone without launching an app like Shazam.

The built-in history means that when I get back home, I can scroll through the music I discovered and play it through my streaming app of choice. It's helped me discover some of my favorite artists.

How about a throwback? Remember Active Edge? The feature launched with the Pixel 2 and allowed you to launch Google Assistant by squeezing the sides of the phone. It sounded like a gimmick, but I was hooked within a day of using it.

I remember using it while doing chores around the house. No need to press a button or use wake words to call out. Google even let you adjust the sensitivity to avoid accidental activations.

It was great, and we just don't see that style of innovation anymore.

The features weren't trying to be features for the sake of it. They actually solved problems users like me faced every day, and that's what made them great.

AI should enhance the Pixel's features, not define it

Google's focus on everyday conveniences was far more memorable

I'm not saying that Google's AI focus has been in vain. Of course not. Pixel phones have introduced a litany of features that have become standards on other devices too.

These AI-powered features solve genuine problems. Be it Call Screening for, well, screening calls, or transcriptions via the Recorder app. Magic Eraser democratized the ability to clean up a photo after the fact.

The difference is that those features solve very specific problems.

Transcribing a meeting is a problem that most people don't have every day. Similarly, it's nice to remove a trash can from a photo, but it's just not something I need or use daily.

Features like Active Edge, on the other hand, were used multiple times a day.

Let me ask you a question. How often do you generate images on your phone? When was the last time you summarized notifications?

The answer will explain why none of these features feel quite as iconic or hit as hard as when we first saw Now Playing in action.

While there's no going back from the AI-led future, it's that everyday, solution-oriented innovation and problem-solving that I want to see more of from Google.

Even if it uses AI, my opinion is that AI is at its best when it empowers users instead of becoming a hyper-specific product in itself.

Google shouldn't shy away from its AI ambitions, but perhaps fewer and more thoughtful additions are the answer.

After all, the phones that made me stick through the early years of Google's Pixel lineup weren't exactly technological marvels. They removed little frictions and frustrations from my day without making me switch up my smartphone usage habits.

That's the Pixel I miss and want to see more of.

Google should remember what made the Pixel special

The Pixel earned its reputation for its clean software, but equally because Google eschewed hardware supremacy for a problem-solving approach. It was never about chasing the next big trend, and arguably, still isn't.

AI is undoubtedly reshaping the future of smartphones, but that mindset is what I want to see make a comeback.

AI-everything shouldn't be the end goal. Instead, if Google can leverage AI to enhance everyday usability, the same way it defined the early Pixel years, I feel the Pixel phones will come out stronger.

After all, a great smartphone is about improving daily life instead of cramming in as many AI features as you can.

sentences.zh: 不同之处在于这些功能解决了非常具体的问题。

blocks.html_en: Transcribing a meeting is a problem that most people don't have every day. Similarly, it's nice to remove a trash can from a photo, but it's just not something I need or use daily.

sentences.en: Transcribing a meeting is a problem that most people don't have every day.
sentences.zh: 记录会议记录是大多数人每天都不会遇到的问题。

sentences.en: Similarly, it's nice to remove a trash can from a photo, but it's just not something I need or use daily.
sentences.zh: 同样，从照片中删除垃圾桶也很好，但这不是我每天需要或使用的东西。

blocks.html_en: Features like Active Edge, on the other hand, were used multiple times a day.

sentences.en: Features like Active Edge, on the other hand, were used multiple times a day.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，像 Active Edge 这样的功能每天会被使用多次。

blocks.html_en: Let me ask you a question. How often do you generate images on your phone? When was the last time you summarized notifications?

sentences.en: Let me ask you a question.
sentences.zh: 让我问你一个问题。

sentences.en: How often do you generate images on your phone?
sentences.zh: 您多久在手机上生成图像一次？

sentences.en: When was the last time you summarized notifications?
sentences.zh: 您最后一次总结通知是什么时候？

blocks.html_en: The answer will explain why none of these features feel quite as iconic or hit as hard as when we first saw Now Playing in action.

sentences.en: The answer will explain why none of these features feel quite as iconic or hit as hard as when we first saw Now Playing in action.
sentences.zh: 答案将解释为什么这些功能都不像我们第一次看到“正在播放”时那样具有标志性或冲击力。

blocks.html_en: While there's no going back from the AI-led future, it's that everyday, solution-oriented innovation and problem-solving that I want to see more of from Google.

sentences.en: While there's no going back from the AI-led future, it's that everyday, solution-oriented innovation and problem-solving that I want to see more of from Google.
sentences.zh: 虽然人工智能主导的未来无法回头，但我希望从谷歌看到更多日常的、以解决方案为导向的创新和解决问题的方式。

blocks.html_en: Even if it uses AI, my opinion is that AI is at its best when it empowers users instead of becoming a hyper-specific product in itself.

sentences.en: Even if it uses AI, my opinion is that AI is at its best when it empowers users instead of becoming a hyper-specific product in itself.
sentences.zh: 即使它使用人工智能，我的观点是，当人工智能赋予用户权力而不是本身成为一个超特定的产品时，人工智能才是最好的。

blocks.html_en: Google shouldn't shy away from its AI ambitions, but perhaps fewer and more thoughtful additions are the answer.

sentences.en: Google shouldn't shy away from its AI ambitions, but perhaps fewer and more thoughtful additions are the answer.
sentences.zh: 谷歌不应该回避其人工智能野心，但也许更少、更周到的添加才是答案。

blocks.html_en: After all, the phones that made me stick through the early years of Google's Pixel lineup weren't exactly technological marvels. They removed little frictions and frustrations from my day without making me switch up my smartphone usage habits.

sentences.en: After all, the phones that made me stick through the early years of Google's Pixel lineup weren't exactly technological marvels.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，让我坚持使用 Google Pixel 系列早年的手机并不完全是技术奇迹。

sentences.en: They removed little frictions and frustrations from my day without making me switch up my smartphone usage habits.
sentences.zh: 它们消除了我一天中的一些摩擦和挫折，但没有让我改变我的智能手机使用习惯。

blocks.html_en: That's the Pixel I miss and want to see more of.

sentences.en: That's the Pixel I miss and want to see more of.
sentences.zh: 这就是我怀念并希望看到更多的 Pixel。

blocks.html_en: Google should remember what made the Pixel special

sentences.en: Google should remember what made the Pixel special
sentences.zh: 谷歌应该记住 Pixel 的特别之处

blocks.html_en: The Pixel earned its reputation for its clean software, but equally because Google eschewed hardware supremacy for a problem-solving approach. It was never about chasing the next big trend, and arguably, still isn't.

sentences.en: The Pixel earned its reputation for its clean software, but equally because Google eschewed hardware supremacy for a problem-solving approach.
sentences.zh: Pixel 因其干净的软件而赢得了声誉，但同样是因为谷歌放弃了硬件霸权，转而采用解决问题的方法。

sentences.en: It was never about chasing the next big trend, and arguably, still isn't.
sentences.zh: 它从来都不是为了追逐下一个大趋势，可以说，现在仍然不是。

blocks.html_en: AI is undoubtedly reshaping the future of smartphones, but that mindset is what I want to see make a comeback.

sentences.en: AI is undoubtedly reshaping the future of smartphones, but that mindset is what I want to see make a comeback.
sentences.zh: 人工智能无疑正在重塑智能手机的未来，但我希望看到这种心态卷土重来。

blocks.html_en: AI-everything shouldn't be the end goal. Instead, if Google can leverage AI to enhance everyday usability, the same way it defined the early Pixel years, I feel the Pixel phones will come out stronger.

sentences.en: AI-everything shouldn't be the end goal.
sentences.zh: 人工智能——一切不应该是最终目标。

sentences.en: Instead, if Google can leverage AI to enhance everyday usability, the same way it defined the early Pixel years, I feel the Pixel phones will come out stronger.
sentences.zh: 相反，如果谷歌能够利用人工智能来增强日常可用性，就像它定义早期 Pixel 那样，我认为 Pixel 手机将会变得更强大。

blocks.html_en: After all, a great smartphone is about improving daily life instead of cramming in as many AI features as you can.

sentences.en: After all, a great smartphone is about improving daily life instead of cramming in as many AI features as you can.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，一款出色的智能手机是为了改善日常生活，而不是塞满尽可能多的人工智能功能。

Dhruv Bhutani 自 2010 年以来一直致力于 Android 生态系统，重点关注智能手机、联网设备和家庭网络。 他的报告基于十多年来审查数百款智能手机并测试各种智能家居和音频产品的实践经验。 自 2011 年以来，他已参加八次世界移动大会和五次柏林 IFA，并定期报道谷歌、小米、Oppo 和高通等公司的发布会和行业简报。 这种实地接触和对产品周期的长期接触告诉他如何评估硬件、软件方向和生态系统转变。

如果您在过去几年中一直关注 Google 的 Pixel 智能手机，您可能已经注意到一个反复出现的主题。

几乎所有的头条新闻都围绕着人工智能。 从人工智能驱动的图像生成和照片编辑到写作工具和垃圾邮件过滤，话题几乎总是回到人工智能。

其中一些功能确实有用，而另一些功能则更像是技术演示，但有一点是明确的：实用的软件创新和实验已经很长时间不再是谷歌的首要任务了。

Pixel 的独特之处在于实用创新

“正在播放”和“Active Edge”等功能已成为我日常生活的一部分

最近，我发现自己回想起 Pixel 的早年。

吸引我参加这个阵容的并不是人工智能。 谷歌愿意尝试有趣的硬件创意，并将其与解决实际日常问题的软件功能相结合。

当谷歌没有深入研究人工智能，而是专注于以实用、有意义的方式改善手机使用体验时，Pixel 品牌的感觉会更好。

最好的例子之一就是“正在播放”。 该功能是 Pixel 手机的主要功能，可识别您周围播放的音乐。 此外，它可以直接在锁定屏幕上显示标题和艺术家姓名。 最好的部分是它可以完全离线工作。

在设备上的人工智能出现之前，谷歌就想出了如何压缩包含前 10,000 首最流行曲目的波形的数据库，以便您的手机即使没有互联网连接也可以识别音乐。

这个功能我已经使用了数百次甚至数千次。 无论是坐在咖啡馆里还是在离家一千英里的地方旅行时，如果我喜欢一首曲目，我可以看一眼手机，而无需启动 Shazam 这样的应用程序。

内置历史记录意味着当我回到家时，我可以滚动浏览我发现的音乐并通过我选择的流媒体应用程序播放它。 它帮助我发现了一些我最喜欢的艺术家。

说好的回归呢？ 还记得活动边缘吗？ 该功能随 Pixel 2 一起推出，允许您通过挤压手机两侧来启动 Google Assistant。 这听起来像是一个噱头，但我在使用它一天之内就被迷住了。

我记得在做家务时使用它。 无需按按钮或使用唤醒词来呼叫。 谷歌甚至允许您调整灵敏度以避免意外激活。

这太棒了，我们只是再也看不到那种创新风格了。

这些功能并不是为了成为功能而存在的。 他们实际上解决了像我这样的用户每天面临的问题，这就是他们的伟大之处。

AI 应该增强 Pixel 的功能，而不是定义它

谷歌对日常便利的关注更令人难忘

  • 自动呼叫筛选

我并不是说谷歌对人工智能的关注是徒劳的。 当然不是。 Pixel 手机引入了一系列功能，这些功能也已成为其他设备的标准。

这些人工智能驱动的功能解决了真正的问题。 无论是用于筛选呼叫的呼叫筛选，还是通过录音机应用程序进行转录。 魔术橡皮擦使事后清理照片的能力变得大众化。

不同之处在于这些功能解决了非常具体的问题。

记录会议记录是大多数人每天都不会遇到的问题。 同样，从照片中删除垃圾桶也很好，但这不是我每天需要或使用的东西。

另一方面，像 Active Edge 这样的功能每天会被使用多次。

让我问你一个问题。 您多久在手机上生成图像一次？ 您最后一次总结通知是什么时候？

答案将解释为什么这些功能都不像我们第一次看到“正在播放”时那样具有标志性或冲击力。

虽然人工智能主导的未来无法回头，但我希望从谷歌看到更多日常的、以解决方案为导向的创新和解决问题的方式。

即使它使用人工智能，我的观点是，当人工智能赋予用户权力而不是本身成为一个超特定的产品时，人工智能才是最好的。

谷歌不应该回避其人工智能野心，但也许更少、更周到的添加才是答案。

毕竟，让我坚持使用 Google Pixel 系列早年的手机并不完全是技术奇迹。 它们消除了我一天中的一些摩擦和挫折，但没有让我改变我的智能手机使用习惯。

这就是我怀念并希望看到更多的 Pixel。

谷歌应该记住 Pixel 的特别之处

Pixel 因其干净的软件而赢得了声誉，但同样是因为谷歌放弃了硬件霸权，转而采用解决问题的方法。 它从来都不是为了追逐下一个大趋势，可以说，现在仍然不是。

人工智能无疑正在重塑智能手机的未来，但我希望看到这种心态卷土重来。

人工智能——一切不应该是最终目标。 相反，如果谷歌能够利用人工智能来增强日常可用性，就像它定义早期 Pixel 那样，我认为 Pixel 手机将会变得更强大。

毕竟，一款出色的智能手机是为了改善日常生活，而不是塞满尽可能多的人工智能功能。
